title: Start-End Motion Bridge
subtitle: 9-panel bridge board for completing one action between the first and last frame

panels.label: Start frame
panels.caption: Use the exact beginning pose or shot.
panels.prompt: locked start frame, same protagonist, same room

panels.label: Anticipation
panels.caption: Show the body preparing for movement.
panels.prompt: anticipation beat, small weight shift, same outfit and room

panels.label: Action start
panels.caption: Begin the move clearly.
panels.prompt: action starts, hand lifting or step beginning, same camera family

panels.label: Midpoint A
panels.caption: First bridge frame between the endpoints.
panels.prompt: midpoint A, body rotated partially, same identity

panels.label: Midpoint B
panels.caption: Use the geometric center of the move.
panels.prompt: midpoint B, strongest motion path, same room, same outfit

panels.label: Climax
panels.caption: Show the peak of the move or gesture.
panels.prompt: climax of action, fully committed pose, same protagonist

panels.label: Deceleration
panels.caption: Start calming the movement before the end.
panels.prompt: deceleration beat, movement easing, same camera family

panels.label: Settle
panels.caption: Approach the end position with control.
panels.prompt: settling pose, almost at end frame, same identity

panels.label: End frame
panels.caption: Use the exact ending pose or shot.
panels.prompt: locked end frame, same protagonist, same room
